whenToUse: Admin and back office tables that sort, filter, paginate and select rows
Spreadsheet style editing with cell selection, clipboard and inline edits
Large record sets that need virtualized rows, columns or infinite scroll

whenNotToUse.when: A short static list of rows with no sorting or paging
Records moved as cards between status columns
A folder or category hierarchy with no columns of data

agentNotes: With `manualPagination`, pass the server total to `useTable` as `rowCount` as well as `recordCount`, or the page buttons never render
Give `useTable` a stable `getRowId` whenever rows can be pinned, reordered or virtualized
Swap `DataGridTable` for `DataGridTableVirtual` when rows need virtualization or infinite scroll
